mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS inspectTaskNum, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = '4' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) END AS taskCompleteRate FROM inspect_task WHERE deleted = 0 AND dispatch_time BETWEEN #{statTimeStart} AND #{statTimeEnd}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS inspectUserOnlineNum FROM inspect_user WHERE deleted = 0 AND online_status = '1' -- 假设'1'表示在线
SELECT COUNT(*) AS assetNormalNum FROM asset_info WHERE station_id = #{stationId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = '1' -- 假设'1'表示正常状态
SELECT COUNT(*) AS stockWarnNum FROM asset_stock WHERE station_id = #{stationId} AND deleted = 0 AND warn_threshold > 1 -- 当前库存低于预警阈值
SELECT name FROM station_info WHERE id = #{stationId} AND deleted = 0
